page.overview:
What is Kakariko Village?

In , is the only major settlement. It is located in the western side of the , just south of the . Here there are several , as well as villagers with vital information for . has a number of businesses, including , , a , a tavern, and an inn.

After retrieves the from the , is overrun by who will attack at sight, forcing the villagers to remain inside their homes. It is also at this point that can free the sealed within the located in the middle of . After receives the from the in the , he can play the in front of the statue to reveal a small within. With the awakened, can call it to be transported to specific places in the any time the is played.

In , Kakariko Village is located in the northeastern portion of Hyrule, right next to Hyrule Castle Town and at the foothills of Death Mountain. The town is an entrance to a number of locations, such as the Shadow Temple, the Bottom of the Well, the Graveyard, and the Death Mountain Trail.

The village's origins are elaborated upon during the game, explaining that it was founded by the Sheikah, the guardians of the Royal Family of Hyrule. Moreover, it is revealed that the village was home to only those pertaining to the Sheikah tribe, although it was later opened up to the poor commoners by Impa, who was also born and raised in Kakariko. As such, she is often considered the leader of Kakariko Village, not only for having helped the commoners of Hyrule, but also for her great efforts in turning the village into a great city to equal the bustling metropolis of Hyrule Castle Town.
